about: Each route lists the data sources its responses draw on. Reuse of the data is governed by each source's licence: keep its attribution, and keep share-alike (CC BY-SA) material under the same licence. "unknown" means no licence statement has been found yet.

The transcripts were scraped from bibleproject.com/downloads. For any other use, ask legal@bibleproject.com.

sefaria_malbim.note: Malbim (d. 1879) wrote the text, so the work is in the public domain.
